title: Jailer 2 Hindi Earns Rs 43.8 Crore in 15 Days, Books 68% Profit Over Breakeven
excerpt: Rajinikanth's Tamil film, released in Hindi dubbed version on October 15, has crossed its Rs 26 crore breakeven with Rs 17.8 crore in profit, Koimoi reported — while the all-language India net total reached Rs 429.55 crore and worldwide gross Rs 766.65 crore, according to Sacnilk.
body:
• Jailer 2's Hindi dubbed version has earned Rs 43.8 crore net in India in 15 days, against a breakeven target of Rs 26 crore — a profit of Rs 17.8 crore, or 68.46 percent, according to Koimoi.
  • The Hindi version collected Rs 1.1 crore on day 15, a 12 percent drop from day 14, after a Rs 30.65 crore extended opening week and Rs 13.15 crore in week two.
  • Across all languages, the film's India net total is Rs 429.55 crore and its worldwide gross Rs 766.65 crore after 15 days, according to Sacnilk.
  • To earn a 'hit' verdict on Koimoi's parameters, the Hindi version needs Rs 52 crore net — with about six days of open run before Ramayana Part One releases.

The Hindi dubbed version of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has performed much better than expected at the Indian box office. By the end of its second week it had fetched a profit of over 65 percent, and after 15 days the figure stands at 68.46 percent, making it one of the most successful Kollywood films in Hindi in recent years, according to Koimoi.

The Hindi Numbers, Day by Day

The film, a Tamil-language action thriller released on October 15, 2026, scored Rs 1.1 crore in Hindi on its third Thursday, day 15 — a 12 percent drop from day 14's Rs 1.25 crore, which trade trackers read as a good hold for a dubbed release in its third week. Sacnilk's language-wise tracking matches the figure: the Hindi version collected Rs 1.10 crore on day 15 from 3,972 shows, Sacnilk reported.

The week-wise Hindi breakdown is an extended opening week of Rs 30.65 crore over eight days, followed by Rs 13.15 crore in week two — a 57.1 percent decline that is normal for a front-loaded release — for a 15-day total of Rs 43.8 crore net, or Rs 51.68 crore gross.

Profit, Verdict and the Road to 'Hit'

Jailer 2 (Hindi) had a breakeven target of Rs 26 crore net at the Indian box office. Against that number, Rs 43.8 crore is a profit of Rs 17.8 crore — 68.46 percent — which secures a 'plus' verdict on Koimoi's parameters. A 'hit' verdict requires Rs 52 crore net. With about six days to go before Ramayana Part One's release takes over screens, the Hindi version has a realistic, if narrow, path to that mark.

The Hindi performance sits inside a much larger all-language run. Sacnilk put the film's day-15 India collection at Rs 5.90 crore net across languages — Tamil Rs 3.20 crore, Telugu Rs 1.40 crore, Hindi Rs 1.10 crore and Kannada Rs 20 lakh — taking the total India net to Rs 429.55 crore and India gross to Rs 502.65 crore. Overseas gross reached Rs 264 crore, for a worldwide total of Rs 766.65 crore.

About the Film

Jailer 2 is directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran's Sun Pictures. Alongside Rajinikanth, it stars SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Ramya Krishnan and Vidya Balan in key roles. The film was reportedly made on a budget of Rs 350 crore and released on October 15, 2026, in Tamil with dubbed versions including Hindi — the original language is Tamil.

For the diaspora, the run is playing in North American and Gulf theatres on the strength of the overseas gross; US and Canadian showtimes are listed through the major chains carrying the film, and the Hindi version's hold suggests dubbed South Indian releases now have a durable second market well beyond opening weekend.
